msgs.text: Genera 5 imágenes separadas con Nano Banana 2.1, cada una en su formato y con su referencia (las referencias están adjuntas). Usa los textos tal cual, sin reescribirlos ni añadir nada. REGLA A: Use the EXACT garment(s) and accessories from the reference image: identical cut, length, fabric, colour, print, buttons, trims and details. Do not redesign, recolour or add garments. Show the clothes on a professional female fashion model (a woman). If the reference is a mirror selfie, the new photo has no phone, no mirror and no selfie pose. Photorealistic, high-end commercial photography, natural skin texture, crisp material detail, no text, no letters, no watermark, no logos, no brand names, no frames, no collage, no words or labels anywhere in the image. IMAGEN 1 «h» (formato 16:9, referencia nfrecuencia-17.jpg, aplica la REGLA A): A stylish Spanish woman in her thirties wearing a long brown and black tie-dye print satin wrap dress with wide sleeves and a deep V-neck, for an evening event from the reference, walking at the Plaza del Pilar in Zaragoza, Spain, with the Basilica of El Pilar behind, on a sunny afternoon, golden hour. One single continuous photograph, never a split screen, diptych, panel or collage. The subject stands in the right third of the frame and the same scene continues to the left, softly out of focus and calm, with room for a headline. Wide editorial campaign image, cinematic natural light. IMAGEN 2 «p1» (formato 3:4, referencia nfrecuencia-19.jpg, aplica la REGLA A): E-commerce product photo for a fashion boutique: a model wearing a plum velvet waistcoat with gold buttons and matching wide palazzo trousers from the reference, standing naturally, framed from just above the lips (face cropped at the mouth) down to the shoes so the whole outfit is visible, centred, on a seamless warm light (#ECE7E0) studio background with a soft natural floor shadow, soft diffused daylight from the left. IMAGEN 3 «p2» (formato 3:4, referencia nfrecuencia-18.jpg, aplica la REGLA A): E-commerce product photo for a fashion boutique: a model wearing a burgundy lace two-piece: a long-sleeved lace top and a tiered lace maxi skirt from the reference, standing naturally, framed from just above the lips (face cropped at the mouth) down to the shoes so the whole outfit is visible, centred, on a seamless warm light (#ECE7E0) studio background with a soft natural floor shadow, soft diffused daylight from the left. IMAGEN 4 «p3» (formato 3:4, referencia nfrecuencia-23.jpg, aplica la REGLA A): E-commerce product photo for a fashion boutique: a model wearing a puff-sleeved midi dress with a pink, purple and gold floral print and a square neck from the reference, standing naturally, framed from just above the lips (face cropped at the mouth) down to the shoes so the whole outfit is visible, centred, on a seamless warm light (#ECE7E0) studio background with a soft natural floor shadow, soft diffused daylight from the left. IMAGEN 5 «p4» (formato 3:4, referencia nfrecuencia-13.jpg, aplica la REGLA A): E-commerce product photo for a fashion boutique: a model wearing a long white crepe bridal dress with long sleeves, a high neck and a train from the reference, standing naturally, framed from just above the lips (face cropped at the mouth) down to the shoes so the whole outfit is visible, centred, on a seamless warm light (#ECE7E0) studio background with a soft natural floor shadow, soft diffused daylight from the left.

IMAGEN 1 «p5» (formato 3:4, referencia nfrecuencia-28.jpg, aplica la REGLA A): Footwear e-commerce photo of a pair of grey-blue velvet slingback shoes with a big buckle from the reference, a pair shown at a three-quarter angle, centred and large in the frame on a seamless light (#ECE7E0) background with a soft floor shadow, crisp leather, suede and sole detail. IMAGEN 2 «p6» (formato 3:4, referencia nfrecuencia-32.jpg, aplica la REGLA A): Footwear e-commerce photo of a pair of white satin pointed shoes with a crystal trim from the reference, a pair shown at a three-quarter angle, centred and large in the frame on a seamless light (#ECE7E0) background with a soft floor shadow, crisp leather, suede and sole detail. IMAGEN 3 «l1» (formato 3:4, referencia nfrecuencia-27.jpg, aplica la REGLA A): Lifestyle photo: a pair of burgundy velvet slingback shoes and a matching velvet headpiece on a black round table, like in the reference, soft natural light, editorial, warm and inviting, shallow depth of field. IMAGEN 4 «l2» (formato 3:4, referencia nfrecuencia-12.jpg, aplica la REGLA A): Lifestyle photo: colourful faux-fur stoles in white, pink, red, lilac and blue hanging on a rail, like in the reference, soft natural light, editorial, warm and inviting, shallow depth of field. IMAGEN 5 «b» (formato 16:9, referencia nfrecuencia-05.jpg, aplica la REGLA B): Wide interior photo: the inside of an elegant boutique with patterned wallpaper, gold-framed mirrors, rails of colourful party dresses and coats, shelves of shoes and a cream marble floor, no people, inspired by the reference, photographed like a design magazine, beautiful natural light, inviting and tidy. One single continuous photograph, never a split screen or collage.
